items.stem: Where would you look first to understand how a company recognises revenue?

options.text: The accounting policies within the notes to the financial statements

Marketing material is not the authoritative policy source.

Share price is unrelated to recognition policy.

items.stem: Net profit rose but operating cash flow fell sharply. What is the most reasonable concern to raise?

options.text: Profit may be supported by rising receivables or inventory rather than cash collection
options.rationale: Correct: a profit/cash gap often signals working-capital build-up or aggressive recognition.

options.text: The company must be committing fraud
options.rationale: A gap warrants questions, not an unfounded accusation.

options.text: Nothing, cash flow is irrelevant if profit rises
options.rationale: Cash flow is highly relevant to viability.

options.text: The statements must be arithmetically wrong
